content.title: Have your Easter shopping done? Here's which SC grocery stores are open Sunday
content.text: April 3, 2026, 2:31 p.m. ETEaster Sunday falls this weekend. Have you done all of your shopping?The date of Easter Sunday can sneak up on even those who celebrate, as it changes yearly. This can be a bit of an inconvenience, as many grocery stores are closed or operating on reduced hours during the holiday.With this year's Easter date only a few days away, here's what to know about the hours of some of South Carolina's most popular grocery store chains.When is Easter 2026?This year, Easter falls on Sunday, April 5.Is Easter the same day every year?The Old Farmer's Almanac explains that Easter Sunday is known as a "movable feast" that does not fall on the same calendar date each year. The holiday is observed yearly on the first Sunday after the Paschal Full Moon.Is Walmart open on Easter?Yes, Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter, according to the company's website. Most Walmart stores are open from 6 a.m.-11 p.m. daily.Is Costco open on Easter?No, Costco warehouses will be closed on Easter, according to the company's website.Is Sam's Club open on Easter?No, Sam's Club warehouses will be closed on Easter Sunday, according to the company's website.Is Trader Joe's open on Easter?Yes, Trader Joe's stores will be open during normal hours on Easter.Is Whole Foods open on Easter?According to the company's website, most Whole Foods stores will be open on Easter, but many will close earlier than usual.Customers can use the company's store locator tool to confirm their local store's hours.Is Aldi open on Easter?No, Aldi stores will be closed on Sunday, April 5, according to the company's website.Is Food Lion open on Easter?Yes, Food Lion stores will be open during their normal business hours on Easter.Is Publix open on Easter?No, Publix stores will be closed on Sunday, April 5, the company told USA TODAY.Is Lidl open on Easter?Yes, Lidl stores will be open regular hours on April 5, the company confirmed to USA TODAY.Is Harris Teeter open on Easter?Harris Teeter stores will be open regular hours on Easter, the company told USA TODAY.Is Ingles open on Easter?Yes, Ingles is open on Easter with reduced hours from 7 a.m.-8 p.m.Iris Seaton is the trending news reporter for the Asheville Citizen Times, part of the USA TODAY Network. Reach her at iseaton@citizentimes.com.
